description: PULP APB3 timer F5 behavior: the pulse declared on irq_o[0], the three MMIO writes that start the count, and the count word the ISR reads.
notes: facts copied from configs/scenarios/inprocess-obi-apb-ibex-timer-zipdma-f1f6.json (source_port irq_o, source_bit_offset 0, pulse_width_ticks 16, trigger_writes [[4,0],[8,0],[0,4294967295]], status_offsets [0], status_cause_bits null, clear_writes [])
the same facts are also recorded in configs/scenarios/inprocess-irq-pulp-timer-profile.json and configs/peripherals/pulp_timer/irq_behavior.json for the same RTL
status_offsets [0] is TIMER0_COUNT (rw, 32-bit); the profile declares an unlatched pulse with no acknowledge register, so clear_writes stays empty
the three trigger writes are TIMER0_CTRL(4)=0, TIMER0_CMP(8)=0 and TIMER0_COUNT(0)=0xffffffff, the reviewed sequence that arms one timer0 event
this file states device facts only: the executor still cross-checks them against configs/peripherals/pulp_timer_irq/component_profile.json, and the declaration does not prove the RTL raises the pulse
